subject: executor: fix data race in `IndexNestedLoopHashJoin` (#55824)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: replaces racy `panicErr error` with a publish-once (mutex + `atomic.Bool`) pattern and reads it via atomic guard, preventing concurrent read/write races when workers panic and cancel the join context; adds a failpoint + test to deterministically reproduce the prior ctx-cancel vs panicErr visibility issue. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: the same synchronization approach remains in place, with no later revert indicating a remaining Blocker/High problem.
